networkCapabilityContract.note: Runtime, TypeScript, and OpenAPI enumerate these 29 keys. The 24 QA acceptance records are separate from the key enum; add each future active network key to every contract surface and its QA coverage together.

capabilities.title: macOS packaged home-base runtime
capabilities.acceptance: The built macOS bundle opens the Apple/home-base shell, includes the web runtime, manages backend/proxy explicitly, and supports local signing.

capabilities.title: Shared Apple core contracts
capabilities.acceptance: Shared Swift code has repeatable tests for pairing store, encrypted patient-list cache, patients client, launch overrides, Bonjour discovery, runtime status and optional service diagnostics.

capabilities.title: Mobile paired bootstrap and read
capabilities.acceptance: A booted iPhone/iPad simulator can receive temporary paired credentials, authenticate as operator, read network patients, launch MediFlowMobile and capture an artifact.

capabilities.title: Paired ambulatory write boundary
capabilities.acceptance: The paired client can create, update, promote, delete, and clear a test ambulatory through the versioned network boundary with paired-client audit attribution.

capabilities.title: Paired account PIN rotation
capabilities.acceptance: The paired client rotates its PIN through the shared auth family using client-of-origin re-wrap, a versioned KDF, rotated salt, and conditional server persistence.

capabilities.title: Paired patient profile write
capabilities.acceptance: Network paired write for patient profile/status requires paired credentials, operator session, capability and version conflict handling.

capabilities.title: Paired diary write
capabilities.acceptance: Network paired diary create/update/soft-delete requires paired credentials, operator session, capability and entry version handling.

capabilities.title: Paired therapy write
capabilities.acceptance: Network paired therapy create/update/soft-delete requires paired credentials, operator session, capability and therapy version handling.

capabilities.title: Paired checkup write
capabilities.acceptance: Network paired checkup create/update/soft-delete requires paired credentials, operator session, capability and checkup version handling.

capabilities.title: Paired observation write
capabilities.acceptance: Network paired observation create/update/soft-delete requires paired credentials, operator session, capability and observation version handling.

capabilities.title: Paired catalog read
capabilities.acceptance: Network paired read-only catalog lookup exposes drugs, exemptions and terminology through /api/v1/network/* only for paired clients with operator session and network.catalogs.readonly; catalog sync remains planned separately.

capabilities.title: Paired cross-patient agenda read
capabilities.acceptance: Network paired agenda reads use a distinct capability, mandatory capped limit, plaintext date and status filters, and ambulatory membership scope that excludes patients outside the active ambulatory.

capabilities.title: Paired cross-patient clinical diary read
capabilities.acceptance: Network paired global diary reads use a distinct capability, mandatory capped limit, plaintext filters, ambulatory membership scope, and preserve sealed fields plus soft-delete tombstones for client-side rendering.

capabilities.title: Mobile core CRUD UI
capabilities.acceptance: iPhone/iPad expose usable native list/detail/create/edit flows for the non-AI core modules.

capabilities.title: Mobile offline cache and explicit reconciliation
capabilities.acceptance: Mobile clients keep encrypted derived cache, expose cache age, TTL and stale state, remain read-only while offline, and make the absence of an offline write queue explicit.

capabilities.title: Paired patient lifecycle boundary
capabilities.acceptance: Network paired patient create, soft-delete, restore and tombstone listing are documented in OpenAPI and guarded by the lifecycle capability, sealed sensitive-field checks and optimistic concurrency.

evidence.value: Lifecycle smoke V2 remains the next slice and is not implemented by this boundary slice.

capabilities.title: Paired service prescriptions boundary
capabilities.acceptance: Network paired service prescriptions and items can be listed, created and updated through scoped capability checks, parent membership checks and optimistic concurrency; paired DELETE is intentionally absent.

evidence.value: S1 W2-finale excludes smoke S3 and native changes.

capabilities.title: Paired prosthetic prescriptions boundary
capabilities.acceptance: Network paired prosthetic prescriptions can be listed, created and updated through scoped capability checks and optimistic concurrency; paired DELETE is intentionally absent.

evidence.value: S1 W2-finale excludes smoke S3 and native changes.

capabilities.title: Paired network discovery dual auth
capabilities.acceptance: Network capabilities, identity and node discovery accept either the local API token or paired credentials; paired identity additionally requires an operator session and resolves the cookie-selected ambulatory scope.

evidence.value: S2 W2-finale excludes native and smoke changes.

capabilities.title: Paired network revision boundary
capabilities.acceptance: GET /api/v1/network/revision is paired-authenticated, mode-gated, no-store, and exposes only revision, sourceFingerprint and fingerprint.

evidence.value: S2 W2-finale excludes native guard consumption.

capabilities.title: Paired FSE validation boundary
capabilities.acceptance: Network paired FSE validate-patient and validate-document require paired credentials, operator session and network.fse.validate; validate-patient returns 404 for patients outside scope.

evidence.value: S2 W2-finale excludes smoke S3 and Swift FHIR generation.

capabilities.title: Paired document domain boundary
capabilities.acceptance: Network paired attachment list (metadata only, no data), single-attachment read (with data, 404 cross-patient) and create are guarded by distinct read/write capabilities, an active-and-scoped patient check, sealed name/path/data enforcement, rejection by presence of every document-derived and server-controlled field, and the shared host wire size limit; created attachments enter the OCR queue as pending/paired_upload. Paired update and delete are intentionally absent (ADR 0076, Classe A).

evidence.value: S1 W5 excludes smoke S3 and native changes.

capabilities.title: Paired visit-draft compute and AI runtime status
capabilities.acceptance: The paired client can compute a deterministic review-first visit draft without patient scope, persistence, or mutation audit, and can read fail-closed AI kill-switch status through discovery dual-auth.

evidence.value: S2 W5 excludes smoke S3 and native changes.

capabilities.title: Packaged macOS P6 gate evidence
capabilities.acceptance: PR #21 e WUL-401 hanno consegnato bundle, fixture, probe AX e runbook di base. WUL-481 conserva il gap finche non esistono un home-base temporaneo interamente sintetico con credenziali effimere e cleanup automatico per i percorsi oggi BLOCKED, e una decisione verificabile sul deep-link o sul perimetro dichiarato; solo allora la click-map manuale P6 sul Mac sbloccato puo produrre il verbale verde.
